uncertain_terms.note: Header equipment line mixes a differential protection designation (M87G) with an under-impedance relay description (RADSG); kept as written.
Terminal list in step 15:1:0 repeats '2'; kept as written.
Step 16:26:0 injects at points (4, 3), breaking the pattern of section 16, where the second set uses (8, 5), (8, 6), (8, 7); kept as written.
Sections 17:0:0 and 18:30:0 call the socket 'RTXH 18', the same type as the plug; the expected socket type is RTXP 18. Kept as written.
Relay reference in step 18:30:0 is garbled in the source; rendered as '(x87G)'.
Current transformer reference is written 'CT G2' in step 15:1:0 and 'CTG2' in step 16:30:0; each kept as written.
Element names kept as written in the source, including the lower-case 'dr'.
